meta.title: Mutaba3a — Log it before you forget it

hero.subheadline: Every client, every payment, every expense — captured in seconds on your phone, visible instantly in your hosted portal. Built for growing businesses that move fast.
hero.altNote: Accounts are set up for your organization — there's no public sign-up.

clients.title: Every client on one page.
clients.body: What you did for them, what they owe right now, and when they last paid — together on one page, with nothing to dig for.

payment.title: Paid? Two taps.
payment.body: Tap {action} next to what they paid for. The amount left and today's date are already filled in — tap once more and it's recorded.

businesses.title: Every business you run.
businesses.body: Give each business its own profile, with its own clients and numbers, and switch between them in one click. Dollars, shekels and euros stay apart — never quietly added together.

privacy.title: Your records, on every device you sign in on.
privacy.body: A Mutaba3a account keeps everything behind your sign-in — the same numbers on your phone and in the portal, backed up every day and restorable to any point in the last week.

getIt.title: Get Mutaba3a
getIt.lead: One account for your whole business — the portal in your browser, and the app on your phone.
getIt.requestHint: Tell us about your work and we'll reply within 2 working days with an offer.
getIt.signInCta: Already have an account? Sign in
getIt.appsLabel: Already set up? Get the app
getIt.note: Accounts are set up for your organization — there's no public sign-up.

phone.title: Log it on your phone. See it all in your hosted account.
phone.body: The phone app is for logging: an income or an expense in seconds, even with no signal. The portal, your hosted account in a browser, is where you see it all: every client, what they owe and what they’ve paid, on any computer.
phone.hint: Both come with the same account.
phone.devicesCaption: Logged on the phone, there in the portal.

malafat.title: Run a law firm or accounting office on Malafat? Mutaba3a connects to it.
malafat.body: Malafat keeps each firm's fee proposals and agreements, and what every client owes and has paid. Link your firm's Malafat to your account, and a payment you log in the Mutaba3a phone app reaches Malafat under its client, unallocated, for the firm to apply to what's owed.

faq.headline: Questions
faq.a1: No — accounts are set up for your organization, with pricing based on what you need. Request an account and we'll reply with an offer.
faq.a2: On Mutaba3a's servers, behind your sign-in — not only on one device. We back up every day and can restore your records to any point in the last 7 days.
faq.q3: How do I back up, or move to another device?
faq.a3: Nothing to do — your account is the backup. Sign in on a new device and everything you've logged is already there.
faq.q4: Can I track more than one business?
faq.a4: Yes. Give each business its own profile, with its own clients and income, and switch between them in one click.
faq.a5: {currencies}. Each amount keeps the currency it was earned in, and totals are shown per currency — never converted behind your back.
faq.q6: Does it work offline, or on my phone?
faq.a6: The hosted portal works in any browser — sign in and your records are there. The phone app is built for offline capture: log an expense with no signal, and it uploads the moment you're back online.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy covers Mutaba3a's hosted web portal and its iPhone and Android apps. They all work the same way: you sign in with an account, and what you enter is saved to Mutaba3a's servers. It does not cover any other product.

scope.title: The short version
scope.body: Mutaba3a is a hosted product. You sign in with an account, and what you enter — clients, projects, income, expenses, receipts — is saved to our servers so it's there on every device you sign in on. Our website sends us what you type in the account-request form, only if you fill it in and press Send, and it counts visits anonymously, as described under "Anonymous usage counts". None of our apps use ads or tracking, and we never sell your data.

mobile.title: iPhone and Android: your account and our servers
mobile.body: The mobile apps need an account, which your organization or we set up for you. There's no public sign-up. When you sign in, we keep your email address, display name, language, and which business profiles you can use. What you enter is stored on Mutaba3a's servers, and a copy is kept on your phone so the app works offline. Entries you make while offline are saved on your phone and uploaded once you're back online. Signing out ends your session on our servers. Entries that haven't uploaded yet stay on the phone and upload after you sign in again.

hostedAccounts.title: Where your records live
hostedAccounts.body: Your account (the web portal, and the iPhone and Android apps when you're signed in) keeps your records on Mutaba3a's servers in Google Cloud's Tel Aviv region (me-west1). We back them up every day and keep each backup for 14 days, and we can restore your records to any moment in the last 7 days. When something breaks, an error report goes to Sentry in the EU with the content of your records removed. Usage counts go to PostHog in the EU only if you agree. Our team opens your records only when you ask us to help, to fix a fault, or when the law requires it. When you close your account, we delete it and its records after 30 days, including the record that you accepted our terms, and our backups clear 14 days later. Accounts are also covered by our terms of service.

whatYouEnter.title: What you enter
whatYouEnter.body: You control what goes into Mutaba3a: client names and contact details, projects, income records, optional expenses, notes, and any receipts you attach. It's sent to our servers so it can be stored with your account. On iPhone, you can share a photo or PDF of a receipt into Mutaba3a. It's uploaded to private cloud storage and attached to the expense.

network.title: What reaches the network
network.body: The website's account-request form sends what you type in it to Netlify when you press Send. The website also sends the anonymous visit counts described under "Anonymous usage counts" to PostHog. The hosted portal connects to Mutaba3a's servers and, if you turned on anonymous usage, to PostHog. The mobile apps connect to Mutaba3a's servers, to the private storage that holds your receipts, and, if you turned on anonymous usage, to PostHog, always over encrypted connections.

sharing.title: Who else handles your data
sharing.body: We don't sell your data or share it with advertisers. Our servers and receipt storage run on Google Cloud, which processes the data only to host it for us. Sentry, hosted in the EU, receives the error reports described under "Error reports" and stores them for us. Our website runs on Netlify, which receives the account-request form and checks each request for spam with Akismet (made by Automattic). PostHog, hosted in the EU, processes the anonymous usage counts described under "Anonymous usage counts" for us. If your organization has linked its business profiles to Malafat, the records in those profiles are shared between Malafat and Mutaba3a. Beyond that, we disclose data only when the law requires it.

security.title: Keeping the mobile apps secure
security.body: Your password is stored on our servers only as a secure hash, and never on your phone. Your sign-in session is kept in the iPhone Keychain or in Android's encrypted storage. You can turn on App Lock so opening the app needs Face ID, Touch ID, your fingerprint, or your device passcode. That check happens on your device, and Mutaba3a never receives your biometric data. The mobile apps don't use your camera, contacts, or location, and they only see a photo or file when you choose to share it into the app.

noTracking.title: No ads, no tracking
noTracking.body: None of Mutaba3a's apps use advertising or tracking that follows you across sites or apps. Our servers send error reports when something breaks on our side, as described under "Error reports". The free apps on Mac, Windows, and in the browser never send them. The anonymous usage counts we do keep are described under "Anonymous usage counts". Our servers keep standard technical logs (such as when a request arrived, its IP address, and whether it succeeded) so we can run the service. We don't use them to profile you.

usageAnalytics.title: Anonymous usage counts
usageAnalytics.body: Where we count usage, we use PostHog, hosted in the EU. We never send amounts, names, notes, contact details, your location, or anything you type, and nothing we send is linked to your account. Our website counts page visits and which buttons are pressed, without cookies and without storing anything on your device. To tell visits apart for a single day, PostHog combines your IP address and browser details into a code that changes every day and keeps neither, so a visit can't be linked to you or to visits on other days. The hosted portal asks you once whether you want to share anonymous usage, and it's off unless you turn it on. If you do, it sends a short note when you turn it on (saying whether you did so from the prompt or the account menu), each time you open the portal, and each time you save an income or an expense. A note says only which of these it was, its currency, and for an income whether it was already paid, along with the portal's version and its analytics library's version, its language, your browser's type, your device's operating system and its version, and whether it's a computer, tablet, or phone. Notes are sent under a random ID kept only in your browser, not linked to your account, and replaced when you sign out. If you turn it off from the account menu, we send one last note saying you turned it off, then stop and delete the random ID. The iPhone and Android apps ask you once whether you want to share anonymous usage, and it's off unless you turn it on. If you do, they send a short note each time you turn it on (saying whether you did so from the prompt or Settings), once more the first time you turn it on after signing in, and each time you add a client or save an income or an expense. A note says only which of these it was, its currency, and for an income whether it was already paid, along with the app's version and its analytics library's version, its language, your phone's operating system and its version, and whether it's a phone or a tablet. Notes are sent under a random ID kept only on your phone, not linked to your account, and replaced when you sign out. If you turn it off in Settings, we send one last note saying you turned it off, then stop and delete the random ID. These counts are used only to understand which parts of Mutaba3a people use. They're never used for advertising, and no one but PostHog, which processes them for us, receives them.

errorReports.title: Error reports
errorReports.body: When something breaks, we want to know before you have to tell us. An error report says where in our code the problem happened, which version you were using, your language, and your device's operating system, browser, and model. It never includes amounts, names, notes, contact details, request contents, your IP address, or anything you type. If a report includes an account at all, it is a random internal ID. Reports are stored by Sentry in the EU. Our servers send a report when a request fails on our side.

mobileDeletion.title: Deleting your account and data
mobileDeletion.body: You can delete individual entries in the mobile apps. To delete your whole account and everything stored with it, email info@malafat.app from your account's email address, and we'll do it within 30 days. Records in a business profile that belongs to your organization are your organization's, so we handle those together with them. Copies in our backups expire within 14 days of deletion. Signing out and uninstalling the mobile app removes Mutaba3a's data from your phone.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.body: Mutaba3a is a business tool and isn't directed at children. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 13.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, we'll update this page and the "Last updated" date above.

hostedRequest.title: When you ask for an account
hostedRequest.body: If you send the request form on our website, Netlify, which hosts the website, receives what you type: your name, your email and anything else you choose to add, plus the language the page was in and a random request number. Netlify also records technical details such as your IP address and browser, and checks the request for spam with Akismet. Netlify then emails it to us. We use it only to reply with an offer and, if you go ahead, to set up your account. We delete requests within 12 months; write to info@malafat.app and we'll delete yours sooner.
